title: What Eviction Destroys: A Restore-Counterfactual Audit of Forgetting in Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2609.08279v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent memory systems must discard stored information when their history exceeds a fixed token budget. Existing budget-accuracy frontiers quantify the resulting loss in accuracy, but do not distinguish irreversible losses caused by eviction from recoverable retrieval failures. We introduce the restore counterfactual, a per-question paired intervention that reinstates the question's gold evidence in the read-time context and reruns the same reader. Combining the change in correctness with whether the evidence was retained after eviction classifies each oracle-answerable error as recoverable, irreversible, or residual; in the residual case, the answer remains incorrect after restoration. We evaluate FIFO, random, redundancy-aware, and LLM-importance eviction on LongMemEval-S at three budgets and under two retrieval regimes, using GPT-4o-mini as the primary reader and judge and GPT-5.4-mini as a robustness reader. translated_title: 驱逐摧毁了什么：对智能体记忆遗忘的恢复-反事实审计
translated_abstract: 智能体记忆系统在其历史超出固定token预算时必须丢弃已存储的信息。现有的预算-精度前沿只能量化由此造成的精度损失，但无法区分由驱逐导致的不可逆损失与可恢复的检索失败。我们提出了“恢复反事实”这一针对每个问题的成对干预方法：将问题的黄金证据重新放回读取时上下文，并使用同一读取器重新运行。结合正确性的变化以及证据在驱逐后是否被保留，可以将每个在给定标准答案时本可回答正确的错误分类为可恢复、不可逆或残余三类；在残余情况下，即使恢复证据后答案依然错误。我们在LongMemEval-S数据集上的三个预算和两种检索机制下，评估了FIFO、随机、冗余感知和LLM重要性等驱逐策略，使用GPT-4o-mini作为主要读取器和评判器，并使用GPT-5.4-mini作为鲁棒性读取器。在top-k检索下……
tldr: 该论文提出“恢复反事实”审计方法，通过将问题的标准证据重新注入上下文并重新运行读取器，首次将智能体记忆系统的错误区分为可恢复、不可逆和残余三类，从而区分了驱逐造成的永久性损失与可修复的检索失败。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "restore counterfactual" audit, which reinstates each question's gold evidence into the read-time context and reruns the same reader, enabling the first classification of agent memory errors as recoverable, irreversible, or residual—distinguishing permanent losses caused by eviction from recoverable retrieval failures.
